page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening, left portion of scan shown). Full-width title block at top: "LIBER SECUNDUS / De LAPIDIBUS." then italic preface paragraph, then heading "CAPUT I." and subheading in italic; below, one text column with a decorative woodcut initial and small ornamental woodcuts set in the text at left; a catchword-like signature line "G" and "A" at the foot. Page number at top right. Show-through of the reverse page is at top right and is left out.

l.i: Libro superiore egimus de lapillis qui gemmarum nomine,
aut suo, aliquam dignationem habent: nunc quedam
adjiciemus de caeteris lapidibus, ordinem Boetii sequen-
tes, & tantum annotabimus ea quae aut ille non satis explicavit
aut praeterivit: aut quae ab aliis melius explicata
De Stellari lapide; Asteria : Lapide Bufonis.

main_text.l: E Stellari lapide agit Boetius lib. 2.
rus, de figur. lapid. cap. 11.& addit:
Aliquando in hoc lapide non Stellae
nes hic adiungendas iudicavi, ne quid
guit in Stellarem maiorem atque mi-
norem: & eum quem dicit Filicis fron-
ris lapidis, & addit Icones a Gesnero
colniensi, agens de Castro Belvoir: sub
hoc inveniuntur, inquit, Astroites lapides, qui Stellulas invicem

l.i: connexas repraesentant, in quibus radii eminent singulis
angulis quini, & singulis radiis media cavitas subsidet.

page.notes: The initial D is a large woodcut ornamental letter; small woodcut illustrations appear in the text column at left (square, oval stones) and are not printed text. Lines at the foot of the text column are slightly damaged at the left edge (e.g. "hoc", "vicem", "gulis" partly cut by the scan edge). Bottom right of the left page shows faint show-through of the reverse page, omitted.
